title: Model-Based Online Decision Making via Generative Trajectory Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.18677v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Online decision-making faces a tension between efficient inference and long-horizon reasoning. Value-based methods rely on short-horizon bootstrapping that limits the propagation of long-term information, while trajectory optimization methods plan explicitly but must solve a high-dimensional optimization problem at every decision step. We propose Generative Trajectory Planning (GTP), a model-based framework that addresses this tension by learning a generative model as a proposal distribution over action sequences. Instead of optimizing sequences from scratch, GTP samples candidate sequences from a diffusion prior and refines them using learned dynamics, reward, and value models, enabling efficient trajectory-level reasoning. translated_title: 基于生成式轨迹规划的模型在线决策
translated_abstract: 在线决策面临高效推理与长时程推理之间的矛盾。基于价值的方法依赖于短时程自举，限制了长期信息的传播，而轨迹优化方法虽然能够进行显式规划，但必须在每个决策步骤求解高维优化问题。我们提出生成式轨迹规划（GTP），这是一种基于模型的框架，通过学习一个生成模型作为动作序列的提议分布来解决这一矛盾。GTP 无需从头优化序列，而是从扩散先验中采样候选序列，并利用学习到的动力学、奖励和价值模型对其进行精炼，从而实现高效的轨迹级推理。在连续控制和长时程操作任务上，GTP 达到或超越了最先进的无模型方法、扩散策略和基于模型的基线，并且在强基线表现不稳定的情境中仍能保持稳定。
tldr: 该论文提出生成式轨迹规划（GTP）框架，通过从扩散先验中采样候选动作序列并用学习到的动力学、奖励和价值模型进行精炼，兼顾了推理效率与长时程推理能力，在连续控制和长时程操作任务上达到或超越了现有最先进基线。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Generative Trajectory Planning (GTP), a model-based framework that samples candidate action sequences from a diffusion prior and refines them with learned dynamics, reward, and value models, achieving efficient trajectory-level reasoning that matches or exceeds state-of-the-art baselines on continuous control and long-horizon manipulation tasks.
